YOUR QUESTIONS

Frequently asked questions

What should I bring to my consultation?

Bring relevant reports, scans and a list of medicines, along with questions you would like to discuss.

How do I find out which treatment is right for me?

An individual assessment helps determine which options or referrals may be appropriate for your needs.

How do I arrange an appointment?

Call the clinic on +91 96697 66111. You can also send an appointment request using the consultation form on our homepage.
